reviews.review_description: Love this game, but please add a multiplayer mode so I can play with friends.

developer_response.body: We're really glad you're enjoying the game. Multiplayer is a great suggestion, and we've added it to our list of ideas for future updates. Stay tuned, and thanks for playing!

Thanks for the feedback, and glad you liked the graphics! We'd love to make the rest of the game just as good. Could you tell us what felt missing or what you'd like to see improved, like gameplay, levels, or controls? Your input will help shape our next updates.
